interpretation_limits: Different field recipes, source regions, mapping methods and resource envelopes; not a controlled cross-scroll benchmark.
Local 175A orientation mismatches support oblique layer-crossing in sampled regions, not a proof about every surface point.
Mapped-area and retained-grid connectivity do not measure physical-sheet correctness.
The current W-50 output is much smaller in geometric source area than the historical Paris4 W-100 output.
No inherent material or scan-quality ranking is established.
